messages:
Amy S: FYI Aquila Labs reports a big tail latency change after we onboarded sable-v1 this morning. p50 same (~140ms) but p95 jumped from ~320ms to ~1.1s and p99 frequently >2s on >8k token requests.

Amy S: example request_id: rq_20250402_44221 and minimal curl they used:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"sable-v1\",\"input\":\"<~9k token doc>\",\"max_tokens\":256}'
```

Amy S: short stack logs (streamgateway & runtime):
```
[streamgateway] rq=rq_20250402_44221 tokenizer: bpe_merge took=410ms path=slow_multibyte
[runtime] rq=rq_20250402_44221 kv_write_ms=520 lock_wait_ms=220 queue_wait_ms=60
```

Raj P: did we change tokenizer tables or apply a merge heuristic for sable-v1? which kernel variant is getting scheduled?

Amy S: manifest for sable-v1: tokenizer_version=tok-3b, bpe_table=v2b, kernel_hint=opt-packed. Canary went live 07:45 UTC, global rollout 08:30 UTC.

Li W: seeing canary hosts show 1.8-2x token counts on long multibyte docs vs sable-v0.9 due to v2b merges splitting emoji/CJK into more subwords. That explodes KV writes and increases lock contention on NVMe-backed kvcache.

Mateo: can we reproduce in staging with the same model+tokenizer? If yes we can toggle manifest and/or route traffic back.

Amy S: uploaded a redacted 9k test to /shared/triage/aquila_sable_repro.txt and a replay command:
```
rt replay --model sable-v1 --input /shared/triage/aquila_sable_repro.txt --repeat 5 --log-level debug
```

deploy-bot: rolling-deploy: sable-v1 full -> 2025-04-02T08:30:12Z

Jenna: customer says their chat UI timed out for some enterprise users; they want immediate mitigation. Can we route their traffic to previous model until fixed?

Li W: short-term mitigations I propose:
- route Aquila Labs' requests >6k tokens to sable-v0.9 variant
- enable prefix_kvcache=true for sable-v1 for that tenant to reduce duplicate writes
- decrease batch_max_tokens to 2048 for sable-v1 to avoid huge internal merges

Raj P: note on kernels: opt-packed is great for dense short batches but degrades on inflated token counts since it uses a single-packed layout. opt-legacy may be better for very long sequences. We should add a kernel fallback rule.

Mateo: I'll create a routing rule. Proposed CLI:
```
redwoodctl routing create --name \"aquila-longctx-fallback\" \
  --match \"model:sable-v1 AND input_tokens>6000 AND customer:AquilaLabs\" \
  --target \"model:sable-v0.9\" --priority 850
```
Ack to apply?

Amy S: customer requested immediate reroute. Ack.

Mateo: applied. routing rule active. Monitoring p99 for the next 10m.

Li W: on runtime I can toggle a manifest override on canaries to set bpe_table=v1 and also flip kernel_hint to opt-legacy for hosts handling long contexts. Will do on a small subset first.

Raj P: also enabling incremental_kv_flush to smooth write IO spikes might help. Config suggestion:
```
runtime.config set sable-v1 incremental_kv_flush=true
batcher.max_tokens=2048
timeout.kv_write_ms=700
```

support-bot: alert created: #inc-2025-04-02-2211 \"sable-v1 long-context tail latency\" assigned to eng-runtime.

Amy S: quick snapshot after routing change (5m): p99 for Aquila Labs traffic fell from ~2.1s -> ~430ms. Overall sable-v1 fleet p99 remains elevated due to other tenants still on global rollout.

Jenna: Aquila confirms their UI is responsive again. CTO wants RCA and ETA for cluster-wide remediation before we flip them back.

Li W: preliminary RCA: bpe_table=v2b produces finer-grained merges for multibyte and emoji sequences, increasing token counts and KV churn -> longer kv write latency and lock waits. Secondary contributor: opt-packed kernel choice that doesn't handle the inflated token shapes efficiently.

Raj P: action items & ETAs:
1) rollback tokenizer table on canary and stable hosts (Li) - ETA 25m
2) limit batcher.max_tokens and enable incremental_kv_flush cluster-wide for sable-v1 (Mateo) - ETA 40m
3) run a 1hr replay across 12 canaries and collect pprof + flamegraphs (Amy/Raj) - ETA 1.5h
4) ML follow-up: normalize multibyte clusters prior to BPE merge and add evals to guard quality regression (Li/ML) - ETA 4d

Mateo: created dashboard tile sable-v1.kv_lock_wait_p99 and set alert if >600ms. I'll escalate to SRE if triggered.

Amy S: adding notes to Aquila support ticket and cc'ing CS. Will post pprof results when ready. Closing immediate escaltion as customer routed off breaking variant. Will reopen if p99 rebounds for them.

Li W: tokenizer patch is small but will need eval runs to ensure generation quality unaffected; adding it to the eval harness queue.

Jenna: I'll prepare comms and a timeline for Aquila once we have pprof and test results.

Amy S: thanks all. Summary added to ticket.

-- end of thread --
